'''Filoniville''' was a destination on Coruscant's subtram in the Coruscant underworld.

==Behind the scenes==
The name was inserted onto the subtram map as an in-joke by the production team, along with the other destinations on the map, referencing ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' series showrunner Dave Filoni.<ref name="To Catch a Jedi trivia gallery">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep519|text="To Catch a Jedi" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref>
